```{r}
install.packages("lavaan")
install.packages("foreign")
install.packages("semPlot")
library(foreign)
library(semPlot)
library(lavaan)
dataset <- dataset
head(dataset)
```

```{r}
cfa_data <- dataset[dataset$Subsample == 2,]
cfa_data
```

```{r}

shame_model <- '
Factor1 =~ S3SG1 + S2SG2 + S3SG3 + S3SG4 + S1SG5 + S3SG6 + S2SG7 + S3SG8
Factor2 =~ S1SG9 + S1SG11 + S2SG12 + S1SG13
'

# Fit the CFA model
fit1 <- cfa(shame_model, data = cfa_data)

# Get comprehensive model fit statistics
summary(fit1, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```
```{r}
modificationindices(fit1, minimum.value = 10)
```

```{r}
semPaths(fit1, "std", layout = "tree")
```
```{r}
semPlot::semPaths(fit1)
```

```{r}
avoidance_model2 <- '
f1 =~ A2AC1 + A3AC2 + A2AC3 + A2AC5 + A2AC7
f2 =~ A1AC9 + A1AC10 + A1AC11 + A1AC12
A1AC11	~~	A1AC12
	A2AC5	~~	A2AC7
	A2AC1	~~	A2AC3
'

# Fit the CFA model
fit3 <- cfa(avoidance_model2, data = cfa_data)

# Get comprehensive model fit statistics
summary(fit3, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```

```{r}
modificationindices(fit3, minimum.value = 10)
```
```{r}
# Get summary of largest residuals
resid <- residuals(fit3, type = "standardized")
round(max(abs(resid$cov)), 3)
```
```{r}
# Get the full residual matrix
resid_matrix <- residuals(fit3, type = "standardized")$cov

# Find the pairs with large residuals (>2.58)
high_resids <- which(abs(resid_matrix) > 2.58, arr.ind = TRUE)
print(resid_matrix[high_resids])
```


```{r}
# Create a matrix of TRUE/FALSE for residuals > 2.58
high_pairs <- abs(resid_matrix) > 2.58
```


```{r}
# Get row and column indices of high residuals
high_indices <- which(high_pairs, arr.ind = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Create a data frame showing the variable pairs and their residuals
residual_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable1 = rownames(resid_matrix)[high_indices[,1]],
  Variable2 = colnames(resid_matrix)[high_indices[,2]],
  Residual = resid_matrix[high_pairs]
)
residual_summary
```

```{r}
second_order_model_revised <- '
  # Reorganize first-order factors
  formal =~ A2AC4 + A2AC6 + A2AC7      # Work and institutional contexts
  informal =~ A2AC1 + A3AC2 + A2AC3 + A2AC5   # Social and personal contexts
  f2 =~ A1AC9 + A1AC10 + A1AC11 + A1AC12
  
  # Second-order factor
  general =~ NA*formal + informal + f2
  
  # Fix the variance of the general factor to 1
  general ~~ 1*general
  
  # Maintain error correlations
  A1AC11 ~~ A1AC12
'
```


```{r}
bifactor_model_avoidance <- '
  g =~ A2AC1 + A3AC2 + A2AC3 + A2AC4 + A2AC5 + A2AC6 + A2AC7 + A1AC9 + A1AC10 + A1AC11 + A1AC12
  

  f1 =~ A2AC1 + A3AC2 + A2AC3 + A2AC4 + A2AC5 + A2AC6 + A2AC7
  f2 =~ A1AC9 + A1AC10 + A1AC11 + A1AC12
  
  A1AC11 ~~ A1AC12

  
  # Orthogonality constraints
  g ~~ 0*f1
  g ~~ 0*f2
  f1 ~~ 0*f2
'

# Fit the CFA model
fit_bi_av <- cfa(bifactor_model_avoidance, data = cfa_data)

# Get comprehensive model fit statistics
summary(fit_bi_av, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```

```{r}
modificationindices(fit_bi_av, minimum.value = 10)
```

```{r}
semPlot::semPaths(fit_bi_av)
```

```{r}
second_order_model_revised <- '
  public =~ A2AC1 + A3AC2                     # Public sphere disclosure
  close =~ A2AC3 + A2AC4 + A2AC5              # Close relationships
  community =~ A2AC6 + A2AC7                  # Professional/community relationships
  f2 =~ A1AC9 + A1AC10 + A1AC11 + A1AC12     # Original second factor
  

  general =~ NA*public + close + community + f2
  

  general ~~ 1*general
  

  A1AC11 ~~ A1AC12
'
```

```{r}
# Fit the CFA model
fit_sec_av_re <- cfa(second_order_model_revised, data = cfa_data)

# Get comprehensive model fit statistics
summary(fit_sec_av_re, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
# Filter out "Don't Know" responses and create clean dataset
# Exclude groups 1, 2, and 7
dataset_clean <- dataset %>%
  filter(!(Income %in% c(1, 2, 7)))

```


```{r}
# Specify your CFA model (based on your factor structure)
shame_model <- '
  Factor1 =~ S3SG4 + S3SG3 + S1SG5 + S3SG8 + S3SG1 + S2SG2 + S3SG6 + S2SG7
  Factor2 =~ S2SG12 + S1SG9 + S1SG13
  S2SG2 ~~ S2SG12
  S3SG4 ~~ S3SG3
'
```


```{r}
# Test configural invariance
configural <- cfa(shame_model, 
                 data = dataset_clean, 
                 group = "Income")
```


```{r}
# Test metric invariance (equal factor loadings)
metric <- cfa(shame_model, 
             data = dataset_clean, 
             group = "Income",
             group.equal = "loadings")
```


```{r}
# Test scalar invariance (equal intercepts)
scalar <- cfa(shame_model, 
             data = dataset_clean, 
             group = "Income",
             group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts"))
```


```{r}
# Compare models
anova(configural, metric, scalar)
```


```{r}
# Examine fit measures for each model
fitMeasures(configural, c("cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
fitMeasures(metric, c("cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
fitMeasures(scalar, c("cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
```

